notes.title: 🔥MARKET GARDEN - Release date trailer!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/74399c907c2e77de19ca30227ecf5a94902c3e79.png"]


Hello friends! 👋
📢 It’s time for a big announcement — are you ready?



The moment has come… 🎉

I'm thrilled to officially announce the release date of MARKET GARDEN!



🚨 MARKET GARDEN launches on August 1st!



For this occasion, I'm really excited to share a new Release Date trailer, which shows some never-before-seen locations!



🎬 You can watch release date trailer here:

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cXTEUdmZRl0"][/dynamiclink]

🛠️ Also, feel free to check out the refreshed MARKET GARDEN Steam Store page — with new GIFs, updated screenshots, fresh info, and plenty of exciting news!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/e9641ad1619900c8bed06ff682afe6b75be87fad.png"]



I hope you’re as excited as I am — and that you’ll have a great time playing when the game launches!

All the best,
Tom | Icy Bayts

notes.title: ⚙️ MARKET GARDEN - Update 0.1 - Fixes & Improvements!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/74399c907c2e77de19ca30227ecf5a94902c3e79.png"]

Hello friends! 👋
Your feedback over the past few days has been absolutely priceless — thank you from the bottom of my heart. ❤️



This update brings a mix of bug fixes, ultrawide monitor support, community-suggested changes, and a range of quality-of-life improvements.



📝 Note:

It’s not required to delete your old profile and create a new one — but it’s recommended, especially if you run into any issues.



✅ Ultrawide monitors support added

Improved experience for ultrawide monitor users. This feature is still experimental — if you run into any issues, don’t hesitate to reach out!



✅ Seamless input switching

Improved behavior when using both a controller and mouse/keyboard. You can now switch between them at any time — no need to disconnect your controller!



✅ Music volume setting 

Adjust music volume to your liking.



✅ New aim sensitivity option 

Customize sensitivity while aiming for better precision.



✅ Bolt-action improvements 

No more instant snapback! After firing, the view now stays zoomed-in briefly so you can see if your shot landed before entering the reload animation. Also, when holding the right mouse button, you’ll automatically return to aiming after cycling the bolt.



✅ Invert controls (vertical axis only)

Invert mouse option now works as intended — only the vertical axis is affected.



✅ Custom key bindings for weapon switching 

You can now rebind keyboard keys for switching weapons.



✅ Pixelization effect disabled by default 

I noticed many of you turning pixelization off right away — I hear you! It’s now set to 0 by default for a crisper look.



✅ Faster item pickup

Items are now picked up more quickly for smoother gameplay.



✅ Smoke grenade performance improvements 

Reduced the performance impact of smoke grenades, especially on Steam Deck.



✅ MP40 aim alignment adjusted
Improved alignment for better accuracy.



✅ Friendly fire from allies disabled
Allies will no longer deal damage to the player.



✅ Steam Deck mouse support 

Due to new seamless input switching - mouse now works correctly on Steam Deck.



✅ Improved AI line of sight behavior 

AI now handles obstacles and line of sight more intelligently.



✅ Reload bug fix after UI change 

Resolved issue where reload prompt could behave incorrectly after weapon change.



✅ Various minor fixes and polish



If your suggestion didn’t make it into this update — don’t worry!

This is just one of many improvements to come. If you run into any issues or have an idea, feel free to reach out!



Thanks again to all of you — and have fun playing the improved MARKET GARDEN demo!
